module_summary: Multi-channel UART SoC: per-channel sync_fifo buffers feed a round-robin arbiter whose one-hot grant muxes the winning byte into a uart_tx serializer.

anchors.name: ch_valid
anchors.why: Per-channel input valid into each channel FIFO write port.

anchors.name: ch_ready
anchors.why: Per-channel FIFO not-full ready back to the channel producers.

anchors.name: ch_data
anchors.why: Per-channel input bytes written into the channel FIFOs.

anchors.name: uart_tx
anchors.why: Serial UART line output driven by the uart_tx child.

anchors.name: uart_busy
anchors.why: Level busy indication from the UART transmitter.

anchors.name: fifo_valid
anchors.why: FIFO non-empty flags acting as request vector into the arbiter.

anchors.name: fifo_data
anchors.why: Head bytes of each channel FIFO, candidates for the grant mux.

anchors.name: gnt
anchors.why: One-hot grant selecting which FIFO's byte goes to the UART and which pops.

anchors.name: gnt_valid
anchors.why: Arbiter grant-valid, copied directly onto tx_valid.

anchors.name: tx_valid
anchors.why: Valid of granted byte into the UART; with tx_ready forms accept/pop.

anchors.name: tx_ready
anchors.why: UART ready; accepting a byte pops the granted FIFO and releases arbiter lock.

anchors.name: fifo_pop
anchors.why: Per-channel pop: grant ANDed with UART handshake, dequeues the winning FIFO.

anchors.name: tx_byte
anchors.why: Byte selected by one-hot grant mux, sent as UART tx_data.

groups.name: channel_fifos
groups.description: Per-channel sync_fifo buffers accepting channel bytes and popped on grant acceptance.

groups.name: round_robin_arbiter
groups.description: rr_arbiter grants one non-empty FIFO, locked until the UART accepts its byte.

groups.name: grant_mux
groups.description: One-hot mux picking the granted FIFO head byte for transmission.

groups.name: uart_transmitter
groups.description: uart_tx serializes the selected byte onto the UART line, reporting ready/busy.
